title: Looking for people to try out my AI Spritesheet maker! You can bulk generate spritesheets, bulk export, and edit them in natural language - looking for help in improving the experience
author: AISpritesheetMaker
selftext:
www.aispritesheetmaker.com

You can check out the features page for more info, but the whole idea of my app is that I want to make it easy for you to basically auto generate spritesheet assets in bulk, with the same style, look and feel, with easy and intuitive ways to guide the process. It's not quite there on the easy and intuitive, but it's getting there! Before I add any more features, I would love to have a few people try out the generation and give me feedback. 

Take a look at that app, make an account, maybe try one of the free generations and if you are interested, shoot me a message here and if I haven't done it too much yet, I'll give you credits and let you try making a bunch of generations for free, or rather, in exchange for your feedback! 

Okay thanks for your time!

replies.author: AISpritesheetMaker
replies.body: What do you think would be more reasonable pricing? Nothing is set in stone, still very much early days

replies.author: Able_Zombie_7859
replies.body: For example nano banana costs about 3 cents per image..you are charging over ten dollars for ..20 generations? You are so absurdly out of line on pricing there isn't much to talk about and at this point even if you changed it I wouldn't use it because of the impression this left. Would never to be a full order of magnitude more generations at the outset to be even considered. Many generations fail. Indo 20 generations of a single concept often. I am sharing your price list for entertainment among friends though.

replies.author: AISpritesheetMaker
replies.body:
Well, I'm using under the hood - gpt image 1 to generate the image. I then have additional post processing steps with nano banana (very newly introduced). The combo is about 18c per image. 

The costs also vary, the highest cost is about 1 dollar per credit, but the best deal is about 40c per credit. 

In that respect, where do you think I can improve pricing?

replies.author: Able_Zombie_7859
replies.body: I just wouldn't use it at those prices. Good luck.

replies.author: AISpritesheetMaker
replies.body: Well that's fair - I expect prices to drop pretty quickly, as these things tend to do, maybe when they do -and I'm able to pass on those price drops to users - it'll appeal to you more, until then - thank you for your feedback?
